notes: Stories defined for facade orchestration covering schema, core logic, API integration, and testing.

stories.title: Facade Input/Output Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request and response schemas for EvaluateCare facade covering clinical trial search inputs and provider detail lookup (NPI). Ensure alignment with existing Pydantic tool models and domain service contracts.

stories.title: Facade Orchestration Logic for Clinical Trials
stories.description: Implement orchestration logic in the facade to call clinical_trials_service, apply filters (e.g., recruiting), enrich with travel data, and format results for downstream consumption.

stories.title: Facade Orchestration Logic for Provider Detail Lookup
stories.description: Implement orchestration logic in the facade to retrieve provider details via NPI, enrich with state board links and research URLs, and normalize output structure.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Integrate EvaluateCare facade with tool_router to enable controlled invocation via LLM tool-use, ensuring input validation and allowlist enforcement.

stories.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop tests validating facade orchestration for both clinical trials and provider detail flows, including happy paths, invalid inputs, and service failure handling.

per_feature.mitigation: Reuse existing domain services and enforce strict schema validation via Pydantic.
